notes.source: Trailing-twelve-month (TTM) quarterly series computed from SEC EDGAR companyfacts (discrete quarterly values; Q4 = FY annual minus Q1-Q3). MA and V series computed the same way Nov 5, 2026 from companyfacts. ASML is in EUR (IFRS filer, carried forward whole).
notes.units: rev_m / fcf_m / ebita_m are USD millions (EUR millions for ASML); eps is USD per share (EUR for ASML).
notes.ebita_missing: EBITA is null for MA and V: AmortizationOfIntangibleAssets is tagged annually only (10-K) in EDGAR companyfacts for both, so a quarterly TTM EBITA cannot be derived. V EPS is also null: no diluted-EPS or share-count tags exist for Visa in companyfacts. V FCF IS available (OCF minus capex, capex via the PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets tag - Visa tags capex there, not under PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment). GOOG and META EBITA are null in appended quarters: their amortization is disclosed in the 10-Q notes, not as a quarterly companyfacts tag. NFLX EBITA equals operating income (no amortization tag at all).
notes.asml_core_pe_note: Fixed Nov 6, 2026: ASML ttm_op_income in stocks-data.json is now the USD figure ($17,098,148,000 = EUR 15,220,000,000 x 1.1234 EUR/USD), and core P/E is 34.8x on a USD-consistent basis (EV ~$595.1B, as implied by the old 39.1x). ASML Fundamental points remain in EUR (rate_eur_usd 1.1234); ASML is never appended by the script (IFRS filer, carried forward whole).
